## Recommended squash commit message

Copy the two fields into the "Squash and merge" form.

**Commit title**

```text
<Summary in the imperative form> (#<pull request>)
```

**Extended description**

```text
<One short paragraph that tells what changed and why.>

- <Main change>
- <Main change>

Closes #<issue>

<Attribution lines, if a Claude Code session did the work>
```
